obfuscation_indicators: may be unable to continue as a going concern
risk_summary: The disclosure contains substantial quantified detail on the convertible debenture and revenue policies, but the lengthy promotional overview and forward-looking claims dilute the financial risk discussion. Material concerns include persistent losses, negative operating cash flow, dependence on additional financing, and defaults on lease and debt obligations. Management explicitly states that the Company may be unable to continue as a going concern, with no assurance that liability negotiations or financing efforts will succeed.
